title: Dual-stream safe replication and budgeted sampling for model trial traffic
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Goal: Build a production-safe 'replicated request' pipeline that duplicates a controlled fraction of live inference traffic into trial model variants without increasing tenant risk or runaway cost. This work covers deterministic sampling, per-tenant budget throttles, tenant isolation for trial streams, end-to-end tracing, and automated rollback triggers for quality or cost regressions. The implementation must be compatible with hosted, dedicated, and private deployments and integrate with billing meters and the Console rollout controls.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Requests can be replicated to a trial model stream with an enforced token budget per tenant that prevents any tenant from exceeding their configured spend cap.
2) Sampling is deterministic and reproducible per request id/seed to allow post-hoc A/B pairing for evaluation.
3) Replicated requests run in an isolated runtime lane that cannot consume production GPU pools beyond configured burst capacity.
4) End-to-end traces show original->replica linkage and appear in Grafana/JAeger with tenant tag and replica variant ID.
5) Auto-rollback triggers (quality delta > 5% on evaluation prompts OR cost-per-1k-requests increase > 30% for 15m window) are firing and documented in Console and incident playbooks.
6) Integration tests and canary run demonstrate <1% added 95p latency to the primary request path under expected load with replication sampling <= 5%.
7) Audit logs include replica decision, sampling seed, and de-identified input hash for privacy regulations.
pr_links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/989 - Console UI controls for trial budgets
implementation_notes: Pipeline split happens at the ingress gateway: ID request -> deterministic sampler -> primary path + trial stream forwarder.
Deterministic sampling uses HMAC(request_id, tenant_salt, variant_id) mod 10000 < sample_rate_x100 to allow stable A/B pairings.

Per-tenant budget controller tracks token budget consumed by replicated stream using a token-weighted meter and enforces a hard deny once budget exhausted; budgets configurable in Console per tenant and linked to billing account.

Replica lanes are scheduled on a separate GPU pool (replica-pool) with strict burst capacity and preemption policies to avoid impacting production pools; on Dedicated customers, replica-pool can be disabled.
All replica responses are tagged with replica.headers.x-replica-id and original request link for traceability.
To minimize cost during high traffic, introduce adaptive downsampling tied to rolling cost thresholds and a light-weight 1-min cooldown signal to reduce sampling automatically.
Record de-identified input hashes (SHA256 prefix) for evaluation and compliance; full payloads stored only if tenant explicitly opts in for deep analysis.
Instrumentation: metrics emitted for replica_token_cost_per_min, replica_qps, replica_error_rate, primary_delta_latency_ms, replica_budget_exhausted_count.
Fallback: if replica-pool is saturated, trial stream switches to a no-op logger mode (store request metadata only) to preserve pairing without incurring inference cost.
testing_plan: Unit tests for deterministic sampler (edge cases for boundary sample rates 0/100%).
Integration tests that assert budget enforcement under synthetic token-heavy requests.
Load test scenario: 10k rps primary with 2% replication to verify primary p95 latency impact <1%.
Canary in prod: enable for internal tenants (internal-*) and run 48h smoke exercise comparing baseline and replica outputs using offline eval harness.
Chaos test: simulate replica-pool failure and verify primary path remains unaffected and alerts surface correctly.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (dev): local simulator + unit tests merged (PR #4123).
Phase 1 (staging): enable for internal tenants with sample_rate=0.5% and budget=10k tokens/day for 72h; observe metrics and logs.
Phase 2 (limited prod): expand to <10 customer tenants nominated by Solutions with sample_rate up to 2% and manual monitoring for 7 days.
Phase 3 (self-serve): expose budget and sample controls in Console with preset safe defaults; enable opt-in for customers.
Phase 4 (GA): unlock higher sample rates and automation for A/B experiments once stability and cost controls validated.
rollback_triggers: Replica-driven primary latency increase >3% sustained for 5 minutes.
Replica_error_rate > 1% absolute increase compared to baseline for 10 minutes.
Replica token spend per tenant exceeds configured daily budget without a corrective throttle.
Any privacy/anonymization audit failure reported by Compliance team.
Manual abort from on-call or PM via Console emergency toggle.
risk_and_mitigations: Cost overrun risk if sample rates misconfigured - mitigated by hard token caps and billing alarms.
Cross-tenant noisy neighbor exposure - mitigated by tenant-aware isolation and dedicated replica pools.
False-positive regression alerts - mitigate with evaluation sets and rolling-window thresholds, escalate to human review before auto-rollback where impact is ambiguous.
Instrumentation gaps - require shipping tracing and metrics before enabling staging; gate enforced in deploy pipeline.
